sections.final_verdict: Choose a minimal-contact strap harness, not a padded vest harness, for a sheepadoodle prone to matting. The best option is the one with the least fabric coverage and the cleanest strap layout.
buying_guide: Prioritize low fabric coverage over plush padding if matting is the main problem.
Look for buckle entry that avoids dragging a harness over the head and ears.
Check where straps sit under the front legs, because that is a common friction zone on doodle coats.
